entries.3906d2c804dce11c: This business supports DX (digital transformation) carried out by customers, drawing on the know-how the company has built up. It provides systems that visualize employee activities, systems that visualize project management information, and systems that digitize ordering processes across multiple sites. It was newly established in April 2021. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥452 million.
